```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
Sys.setenv(VALIDATION_CALIBRATION_ROOT = normalizePath(params$root, mustWork = TRUE))
source(file.path(params$root, "R", "00_paths.R"))
activate_local_lib()
source_vc("05_report_helpers.R")
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
profile <- params$profile
calibration <- read_validation_table("validation_calibration_summary", profile)
```

# Null Directions in Partial-null Scenarios

```{r}
partial_null <- calibration |>
  filter(scenario_family == "partial_binary", is_true_null) |>
  arrange(n, between_r, group, direction)
kable_if_rows(compact_columns(partial_null, c(
  "n", "within_r", "between_r", "group", "direction",
  "attempted", "fit_failure_rate", "retention_rate",
  "rejection_rate_unconditional", "rejection_unconditional_lcl",
  "rejection_unconditional_ucl", "rejection_rate_retained",
  "null_coverage"
)), "False attribution among true-null group-directions")
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
plot_data <- partial_null |>
  mutate(setting = paste0("n=", n, ", between=", between_r))
safe_rate_plot(plot_data, "setting", "rejection_rate_unconditional",
               title = "Partial-null false attribution")
```

# Active Directions

```{r}
active <- calibration |>
  filter(scenario_family == "partial_binary", !is_true_null) |>
  arrange(n, between_r, group, direction) |>
  select(n, within_r, between_r, group, direction, attempted,
         retention_rate, rejection_rate_retained, estimate_mean,
         empirical_sd, model_se_mean)
kable_if_rows(active, "Active-direction summaries")
```
